basic_info.description: Rarely available vacant duplex just steps to the Presidio and Lake Street. The spacious building offers three levels of living over a full garage-basement on a great block. The 1908 structure has an appealing period exterior and large, sunny back yard. The lower flat is remodeled and offers 2br and a split bath. This unit has a kitchen with a Dacor gas cooktop and double ovens, Kitchen Aid fridge and dishwasher, in-unit laundry and a deck overlooking the well-maintained yard. The upper flat is large, featuring two levels of living with 4br and 2ba. The garage level spans the front to back of the structure with a lot of storage and direct access to the back yard.
